title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday Volunteer Night at Convoy of Hope
description: This Giving Tuesday volunteer event, sponsored by the Chamber, has volunteers count, sort, and box or bag product at Convoy of Hope headquarters, with projects depending on needs and supplies. Youth ages 10-17 can take part with parental consent forms, and those 10-12 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian; closed-toe shoes and a current liability waiver are required. It runs Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM at the Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center, One Convoy Drive, Springfield, MO.
venue: Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center
